name: refinery-queue
description: Firebase-native Refinery Truck FIFO Queue & Programming System

scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @refinery/shared build && corepack pnpm --filter @refinery/validation build && corepack pnpm -r test
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @refinery/shared build && corepack pnpm --filter @refinery/validation build && corepack pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.rules-test.json --project refinery-queue-rules-test --only firestore "node --test apps/web/tests/firestoreRules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:workflow: corepack pnpm --filter @refinery/shared build && corepack pnpm --filter @refinery/validation build && corepack pnpm --filter functions build && firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.workflow-test.json --project refinery-queue-workflow-test --only firestore,storage "node --test functions/tests/fleetWorkflow.integration.mjs"
